verdict.rationale: 2FAS's own docs say it generates HOTP and Steam Guard codes alongside TOTP on iOS, Android and the browser extension, which covers two of the four non-standard token types in the story. Nothing in the pack shows configurable TOTP periods or digit lengths; the 'token customization' feature covers only groups, badges, icons and labels, which is a different control. Missing for 10: evidence of custom period support, evidence of custom digit-length support, any detail on HOTP counter handling, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, non-standard tokens work too — Steam Guard, HOTP counters, custom periods and digit lengths

citations.quote: Generate TOTP, HOTP and Steam Guard codes on iOS, Android and via browser extensions.
